title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 451–500 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Badminton is a very popular sport in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 羽毛球在台灣是一項非常熱門的運動。

examples.en: Playing sports teaches children the importance of teamwork and discipline.
examples.zh: 從事運動體育能教會孩子團隊合作與自律的重要性。

examples.en: Our annual school sports day will take place next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們一年一度的學校校運會將在下週五舉行。

examples.en: Baseball is considered Taiwan's national pastime.
examples.zh: 棒球被視為台灣的國球。

examples.en: He hit a stunning home run in the bottom of the ninth inning.
examples.zh: 他在九局下半擊出了一記精彩絕倫的全壘打。

examples.en: Fans cheered loudly at the professional baseball stadium in Taichung.
examples.zh: 球迷在台中職業棒球場上爆發出熱烈的歡呼聲。

examples.en: Let's play basketball on the outdoor court.
examples.zh: 我們去戶外球場打籃球吧。

examples.en: He practiced free throws until he could shoot ten baskets in a row.
examples.zh: 他反覆練習罰球，直到能連續命中十顆籃球為止。

examples.en: Joining the basketball team helped him stay healthy and make loyal friends.
examples.zh: 加入籃球隊讓他維持強健體魄並結交了忠實摯友。

examples.en: Tai Tzu-ying is a world-famous badminton player.
examples.zh: 戴資穎是世界著名的羽球選手。

examples.en: We reserved a court to play doubles badminton after school.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了場地準備放學後去打羽球雙打。

examples.en: A fast-moving badminton shuttlecock requires lightning-quick reflexes.
examples.zh: 疾速飛行的羽毛球需要閃電般的敏捷反應。

examples.en: Lin Yun-ju is an outstanding table tennis star.
examples.zh: 林昀儒是傑出的桌球球星。

examples.en: Table tennis is an indoor game that tests hand-eye coordination and speed.
examples.zh: 桌球是一項考驗手眼協調與極致速度的室內運動。

examples.en: We placed a portable table tennis table in the community recreation room.
examples.zh: 我們在社區育樂室裡放置了一張便攜式桌球桌。

examples.en: We rented a tennis racket to play this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們租了一支網球拍準備這週末去打球。

examples.en: Professional tennis matches on grass courts require precise footwork.
examples.zh: 草地網球場上的職業網球賽需要精準的步法移動。

examples.en: She took private tennis lessons twice a week throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 整個夏天她每週上兩次私人網球課。

examples.en: Millions of fans watch the World Cup soccer matches.
examples.zh: 數百萬球迷觀看世界盃足球賽。

examples.en: He kicked the soccer ball directly into the top corner of the goal net.
examples.zh: 他一腳將足球踢進了球門網的最上方死角。

examples.en: Soccer requires stamina, coordination, and unselfish passing between teammates.
examples.zh: 足球需要耐力、身體協調以及隊友間無私的傳球配合。

examples.en: Going for a swim in the ocean is refreshing in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天去海裡游泳令人神清氣爽。

examples.en: She learned how to swim freestyle and breaststroke during summer camp.
examples.zh: 她在夏令營期間學會了自由式與蛙式的游泳技巧。

examples.en: Dolphins can swim effortlessly at high speeds through ocean currents.
examples.zh: 海豚能毫不費力地在洋流中高速游動。

examples.en: The community swimming pool opens at 6:00 AM.
examples.zh: 社區游泳池早上六點開放。

examples.en: Always follow the lifeguard's safety instructions around the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 在游泳池畔務必遵循救生員的安全指引。

examples.en: The hotel features a rooftop heated swimming pool overlooking the harbor.
examples.zh: 該飯店設有一座俯瞰港灣的頂樓溫水游泳池。

examples.en: Taiwanese people love to sing together at KTV.
examples.zh: 台灣人喜歡一起去 KTV 唱歌。

examples.en: Birds sing melodic tunes in the trees to welcome the morning sunshine.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在樹上唱出悅耳的曲調，迎接清晨的陽光。

examples.en: The choir sang the national anthem with immense pride and harmony.
examples.zh: 合唱團帶著無比的自豪與和諧的合聲演唱國歌。

examples.en: Many teenagers practice street dance after school.
examples.zh: 許多青少年放學後練習街舞。

examples.en: The traditional indigenous dance celebrated the annual autumn harvest.
examples.zh: 傳統原住民舞蹈慶祝著一年一度的秋季豐收。

examples.en: She danced gracefully across the stage during the ballet recital.
examples.zh: 她在芭蕾舞發表會上在舞台間優雅翩翩起舞。

examples.en: Good job! Keep up the great effort.
examples.zh: 做得好！繼續保持這份努力。

examples.en: Finding a fulfilling job requires discovering what you truly enjoy doing.
examples.zh: 尋覓一份有成就感的工作需要發掘你真正喜愛做的事。

examples.en: He works two part-time jobs while completing his college degree.
examples.zh: 他在完成大學學業的同時兼了兩份打工差事。

examples.en: The factory workers are taking a lunch break.
examples.zh: 工廠工人們正在吃午休便當。

examples.en: Construction workers wear yellow protective helmets on building sites.
examples.zh: 建築工人在工地現場佩戴黃色安全帽。

examples.en: Diligent office workers gathered to brainstorm new promotional campaigns.
examples.zh: 勤奮的上班族聚在一起集思廣益構思新的促銷方案。

examples.en: Local farmers grow delicious guavas and wax apples.
examples.zh: 當地農夫種植美味的芭樂和蓮霧。

examples.en: The hardworking farmer starts working in the paddy fields at daybreak.
examples.zh: 辛勤的農民破曉時分就開始在稻田裡辛勤耕作。

examples.en: Organic farmers avoid synthetic pesticides to protect soil and wildlife.
examples.zh: 有機農夫避免使用化學農藥，以守護土壤與野生動植物。

examples.en: The bus driver was friendly and waited for us.
examples.zh: 公車司機很親切且特地等了我們。

examples.en: A cautious driver always maintains a safe following distance on highways.
examples.zh: 謹慎的駕駛在高速公路上總是保持安全跟車距離。

examples.en: The taxi driver shared interesting historic stories about old Taipei neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 計程車司機分享了關於台北老街區有趣的歷史掌故。

examples.en: If you lose your purse, report to the police officer.
examples.zh: 如果遺失錢包，請向警察報案。

examples.en: The alert police officer directed heavy traffic during the rush hour.
examples.zh: 機警的警員在尖峰時段指揮疏導繁忙的車流。

examples.en: Police officers work around the clock to protect public safety.
examples.zh: 警察全天候二十四小時執勤以守護公共安全。

examples.en: The hospital nurse took my temperature gently.
examples.zh: 醫院護理師溫柔地替我量體溫。

examples.en: Dedicated nurses provide compassionate care to patients in the ward.
examples.zh: 盡職盡責的護理師在病房裡給予病患悉心慈愛的照料。

examples.en: She studied nursing at university and passed her licensing exam.
examples.zh: 她在大學攻讀護理學，並通過了護理師執照考試。

examples.en: The convenience store clerk gave me the receipt.
examples.zh: 便利商店店員把發票遞給了我。

examples.en: The friendly bank clerk helped my father open a new savings account.
examples.zh: 親切的銀行行員協助我父親開立了新的儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: The hotel desk clerk checked us into our room within minutes.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃檯接待員在數分鐘內便為我們辦理好入住手續。

examples.en: Jay Chou is an extremely famous Mandopop singer.
examples.zh: 周杰倫是一位極具知名度的華語流行歌手。

examples.en: The lead singer captivated the audience with her powerful vocal range.
examples.zh: 主唱以其極具爆發力的音域震撼了全場觀眾。

examples.en: Aspiring young singers auditioned for the national televised music show.
examples.zh: 抱有夢想的年輕歌手們參加了全國電視音樂節目的海選試鏡。

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a fiction writer.
examples.zh: 她夢想成為一名小說作家。

examples.en: The famous travel writer published a bestselling book about hiking trails.
examples.zh: 著名旅遊作家出版了一本關於健行步道的暢銷著作。

examples.en: A skilled writer uses clear, concise, and vivid language to connect with readers.
examples.zh: 熟練的寫作者運用清晰、簡練且生動的文字與讀者產生共鳴。

examples.en: You can borrow up to ten books from the library.
examples.zh: 你可以在圖書館借多達十本書。

examples.en: Open a can of tuna to make delicious sandwiches for lunch.
examples.zh: 開一罐鮪魚罐頭做美味的三明治當午餐。

examples.en: With sufficient determination and practice, anyone can learn a foreign language.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的決心與練習，任何人都能學會一門外語。

examples.en: Motorcycle riders must wear helmets by law.
examples.zh: 法律規定機車騎士必須佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Visiting the historic night market is an absolute must when traveling in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 造訪歷史悠久的夜市是來台灣旅遊絕對必去的行程。

examples.en: You must wash your hands thoroughly before handling food.
examples.zh: 處理食物前你必須徹底把雙手洗乾淨。

examples.en: You should drink enough warm water every day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該喝足夠的溫開水。

examples.en: Students should review their lecture notes on the same day after class.
examples.zh: 學生應該在課後當天及時複習上課筆記。

examples.en: We should protect natural environments and reduce single-use plastic waste.
examples.zh: 我們應當保護自然環境並減少一次性塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: May I ask a quick question about this lesson?
examples.zh: 請問我可以問一個關於這課的小問題嗎？

examples.en: It may rain later this afternoon, so don't forget your umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午晚些時候可能會下雨，所以別忘了帶傘。

examples.en: You may start writing your examination answers now.
examples.zh: 你們現在可以開始作答考試了。

examples.en: The train will arrive in five minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在五分鐘內抵達。

examples.en: She showed remarkable iron will in overcoming the sports injury.
examples.zh: 她展現了鋼鐵般的堅強意志戰勝了運動傷害。

examples.en: Technology will continue to reshape how people learn and collaborate globally.
examples.zh: 科技將繼續重塑全球人類學習與協同合作的方式。

examples.en: Do your best, and don't worry about mistakes.
examples.zh: 盡你最大努力，別擔心犯錯。

examples.en: What do you do on quiet Sunday mornings?
examples.zh: 在寧靜的週日早晨你通常做些什麼？

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise will do wonders for your mental health.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧運動對你的心理健康大有裨益。

examples.en: Let's make a cup of hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 我們來泡一杯熱巧克力吧。

examples.en: Please make sure that all the classroom windows are closed.
examples.zh: 請務必確認教室的所有窗戶都已關妥。

examples.en: Joining after-school clubs is a fantastic way to make new friends.
examples.zh: 參加課後社團是結交新朋友的絕佳途徑。

examples.en: What time do you get up in the morning?
examples.zh: 你早上通常幾點起床？

examples.en: Get ready quickly, or we will be late for the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 快點準備好，否則我們要趕不上開幕典禮了。

examples.en: She was excited to get a high score on her English listening test.
examples.zh: 她在英文聽力測驗中拿到高分，感到非常興奮。

examples.en: Have a great time at the amusement park!
examples.zh: 在遊樂園玩得開心喔！

examples.en: We have three classes in the morning and three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們上午有三節課，下午也有三節課。

examples.en: Do you have a spare pencil that I could borrow for the exam?
examples.zh: 你有一支多餘的鉛筆可以借我考試用嗎？

examples.en: Let us know if you need any assistance.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何協助，請告訴我們。

examples.en: Let me see the map before we decide which route to take.
examples.zh: 在我們決定走哪條路線之前，先讓我看一下地圖。

examples.en: Don't let minor setbacks discourage you from pursuing your goal.
examples.zh: 別讓一時的小挫折阻止你追求自己的目標。

examples.en: I want to buy some fresh fruit at the market.
examples.zh: 我想在市場買些新鮮水果。

examples.en: Where did you buy that comfortable ergonomic backpack?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那個符合人體工學的舒適背包？

examples.en: Many consumers prefer to buy eco-friendly products to reduce waste.
examples.zh: 許多消費者偏好購買環保產品以減少浪費。

examples.en: You can pay with mobile payment apps here.
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡使用行動支付應用程式付款。

examples.en: Pay close attention to the lab safety instructions given by the teacher.
examples.zh: 密切注意老師所說的實驗室安全注意事項。

examples.en: Persistent practice will ultimately pay off when exam results arrive.
examples.zh: 持續不懈的練習在考試放榜時終將獲得回報。

examples.en: I spent two hours reviewing my English vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我花了兩個小時複習英文單字。

examples.en: How much time do you spend on homework each weekday evening?
examples.zh: 你每個平日晚上花多少時間在功課上？

examples.en: We spent our summer holidays exploring coral reefs and marine biology.
examples.zh: 我們整個暑假都在探索珊瑚礁與海洋生態。

examples.en: How much does a ticket to Kaohsiung cost?
examples.zh: 一張去高雄的車票要多少錢？

examples.en: The heavy typhoon damage cost the city millions of dollars to repair.
examples.zh: 猛烈的颱風災情讓這座城市花費數百萬元進行修復。

examples.en: High living costs in big cities encourage people to budget carefully.
examples.zh: 大城市高昂的生活成本促使人們必須審慎規劃預算。

examples.en: Remember to turn off lights to save electricity.
examples.zh: 記得隨手關燈以節約用電。

examples.en: She saves a portion of her pocket money in the bank every month.
examples.zh: 她每個月都將部分零用錢存入銀行。

examples.en: The brave lifeguard jumped into the water to save the struggling swimmer.
examples.zh: 英勇的救生員跳入水中解救了載浮載沉的溺水者。

examples.en: May I borrow your umbrella? It is pouring.
examples.zh: 我能借用你的雨傘嗎？外面正下著傾盆大雨。

examples.en: Students can borrow up to ten books at a time from our school library.
examples.zh: 學生一次最多可以從我們學校圖書館借閱十本書。

examples.en: English has borrowed many useful words from French, Latin, and German.
examples.zh: 英語從法語、拉丁語與德語中借用了許多實用詞彙。

examples.en: Could you lend me fifty NT dollars for the bus?
examples.zh: 你能借我五十元新台幣搭公車嗎？

examples.en: Can you lend a helping hand to carry these heavy science equipment boxes?
examples.zh: 你能搭把手幫忙搬運這些沉重的實驗器材箱嗎？

examples.en: The municipal library lends audiobooks and digital tablets to registered members.
examples.zh: 市立圖書館向註冊會員借出有聲書與數位平板。

examples.en: Please send me the file via email.
examples.zh: 請透過電子郵件把檔案寄給我。

examples.en: I sent a postcard to my best friend while traveling in Kyoto.
examples.zh: 我在京都旅行時寄了一張明信片給最好的朋友。

examples.en: The school will send text message notifications in case of typhoons.
examples.zh: 學校在遇颱風時會發送手機簡訊通知。

examples.en: Nice to meet you!
examples.zh: 很高興認識你！

examples.en: Let's meet at the MRT station entrance at two o'clock tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天下午兩點在捷運站出入口碰面吧。

examples.en: The student athlete won two gold medals at the regional track meet.
examples.zh: 這位學生運動員在區域田徑運動會上勇奪兩面金牌。

examples.en: Many foreign tourists visit the National Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 許多外國遊客參觀國立故宮博物院。

examples.en: We visit our grandparents in the countryside every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 每年農曆新年我們都會去鄉下探望祖父母。

examples.en: Doctors visit hospitalized patients in the wards every morning.
examples.zh: 醫生每天早晨都會到病房巡視探視住院病患。

examples.en: I love to travel to Japan during winter vacation.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在寒假去日本旅行。

examples.en: Light travels much faster than sound through the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 在大氣中，光傳播的速度遠遠快於聲音。

examples.en: Traveling opens our minds and exposes us to diverse cultures.
examples.zh: 旅行開拓我們的心胸，讓我們接觸豐富多元的文化。

examples.en: Have a safe trip back home!
examples.zh: 祝你返家旅途平安！

examples.en: We went on an unforgettable road trip along the scenic East Coast.
examples.zh: 我們沿著風景優美的東海岸展開了一趟難忘的公路旅行。

examples.en: Watch your step so you don't trip over the tree roots on the trail.
examples.zh: 腳步小心，別在步道上被樹根絆倒了。

examples.en: We booked a cozy hotel room near the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市附近訂了一間溫馨的飯店房間。

examples.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast and shuttle service to the airport.
examples.zh: 飯店提供免費早餐以及往返機場的接駁車服務。

examples.en: Check-in time at this boutique hotel is after three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 這家精品飯店的入住登記時間為下午三點之後。

examples.en: Use Google Maps to find the best route.
examples.zh: 使用 Google 地圖來尋找最佳路線。

examples.en: The MRT network map clearly displays all transfer stations.
examples.zh: 捷運路線圖清楚標示了所有的轉乘站點。

examples.en: Explorers carefully mapped the uncharted coastal islands in the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 探險家在十七世紀仔細繪製了未探明海岸島嶼的地圖。

examples.en: Turn left at the next traffic light.
examples.zh: 在下一個紅綠燈路口左轉。

examples.en: The post office is on the left side of the street.
examples.zh: 郵局位於街道的左手邊。

examples.en: She left her umbrella on the bus by mistake this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上不小心把雨傘遺落在公車上了。

examples.en: The post office is on your right.
examples.zh: 郵局就在你的右手邊。

examples.en: You got all the answers right on today's vocabulary quiz.
examples.zh: 你在今天的單字小考中答對了所有題目。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to receive a good quality education.
examples.zh: 人人都有享有優質教育的權利。

examples.en: Go straight for two blocks and you will see it.
examples.zh: 筆直走兩條街，你就會看到它了。

examples.en: Use a wooden ruler to draw a straight pencil line.
examples.zh: 用木尺畫一條筆直的鉛筆線。

examples.en: He looked me straight in the eye and spoke with complete honesty.
examples.zh: 他直視著我的眼睛，說得十分坦誠真摯。

examples.en: It is your turn to speak now.
examples.zh: 現在輪到你發言了。

examples.en: Please turn right at the intersection after the bridge.
examples.zh: 過橋後請在十字路口右轉。

examples.en: Caterpillars turn into beautiful butterflies through metamorphosis.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲透過完全變態轉變為美麗的蝴蝶。

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
examples.zh: 過馬路前請向兩側看清楚。

examples.en: Walk safely across the pedestrian crosswalk when the walk signal turns green.
examples.zh: 當行人通行號誌變綠燈時，請安全走在斑馬線上過馬路。

examples.en: The red cross on the white ambulance is an international medical symbol.
examples.zh: 白色救護車上的紅十字是國際通用的醫療象徵。

examples.en: There is a 7-Eleven on the street corner.
examples.zh: 街角處有一家 7-Eleven 便利商店。

examples.en: We sat in the quiet corner of the café reading our textbooks.
examples.zh: 我們坐在咖啡廳安靜的角落裡閱讀課本。

examples.en: Good news is just around the corner if you remain persistent.
examples.zh: 只要堅持下去，好消息就在轉角不遠處。
